mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.nickname AS user_name, o.showtime_id, m.id AS movie_id, m.title AS movie_title, m.poster AS movie_poster, c.name AS cinema_name, h.name AS hall_name, s.start_time AS showtime, o.seats, o.seat_count, o.total_price, COALESCE(o.original_price, o.total_price) AS original_price, COALESCE(o.discount_amount, 0) AS discount_amount, COALESCE(o.points_used, 0) AS points_used, COALESCE(o.points_earned, 0) AS points_earned, o.coupon_id, o.status, CASE o.status WHEN 0 THEN '待支付' WHEN 1 THEN '已支付' WHEN 2 THEN '已取消' WHEN 3 THEN '已退款' ELSE '未知' END AS status_text, o.ticket_code, o.is_picked, o.pick_time, o.pay_time, o.remark, o.create_time, o.update_time

FROM ticket_order o LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = o.user_id LEFT JOIN showtime s ON s.id = o.showtime_id LEFT JOIN movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id LEFT JOIN cinema c ON c.id = s.cinema_id LEFT JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id
mapper.select: SELECT m.id AS movieId, m.title AS movieTitle, m.poster AS moviePoster, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS boxOffice, COALESCE(SUM(o.seat_count), 0) AS ticketCount FROM movie m LEFT JOIN showtime s ON s.movie_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.showtime_id = s.id AND o.status = 1 WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.title, m.poster ORDER BY boxOffice DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT m.id AS movieId, m.title AS movieTitle, m.poster AS moviePoster, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS boxOffice, COALESCE(SUM(o.seat_count), 0) AS ticketCount FROM movie m LEFT JOIN showtime s ON s.movie_id = m.id LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.showtime_id = s.id AND o.status = 1 WHERE m.status IN (1, 2) AND m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.title, m.poster ORDER BY boxOffice DESC, ticketCount DESC, m.id ASC

SELECT m.id AS movieId, m.title AS movieTitle, m.poster AS moviePoster, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_price), 0) AS boxOffice, COALESCE(SUM(o.seat_count), 0) AS ticketCount FROM movie m LEFT JOIN showtime s ON s.movie_id = m.id AND s.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN ticket_order o ON o.showtime_id = s.id AND o.status = 1 AND o.pay_time >= #{startTime} AND o.pay_time < #{endTime} WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 GROUP BY m.id, m.title, m.poster ORDER BY boxOffice DESC, ticketCount DESC, m.rating DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) FROM ticket_order WHERE showtime_id = #{showtimeId} AND status = 1

SELECT DATE(pay_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0) AS revenue FROM ticket_order WHERE status = 1 AND pay_time >= #{startTime} AND pay_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(pay_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT movie_id) FROM showtime WHERE cinema_id=#{cinemaId} AND deleted=0) AS movieCount, 1 AS cinemaCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) AS userCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.create_time >= #{startTime} AND o.create_time < #{endTime} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS todayOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status=1 AND o.pay_time >= #{startTime} AND o.pay_time < #{endTime} THEN o.total_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS todayRevenue FROM ticket_order o JOIN showtime s ON s.id=o.showtime_id WHERE s.cinema_id=#{cinemaId}

SELECT DATE(o.pay_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_price),0) AS revenue FROM ticket_order o JOIN showtime s ON s.id=o.showtime_id WHERE s.cinema_id=#{cinemaId} AND o.status=1 AND o.pay_time >= #{startTime} AND o.pay_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(o.pay_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT c.id AS cinemaId, c.name AS cinemaName, COALESCE(seats.totalSeats, 0) AS totalSeats, COALESCE(seats.soldSeats, 0) AS soldSeats, COALESCE(sales.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(sales.orderCount, 0) AS orderCount FROM cinema c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cinema_id, SUM(total_seats) AS totalSeats, SUM(total_seats - available_seats) AS soldSeats FROM showtime WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY cinema_id ) seats ON seats.cinema_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.cinema_id, SUM(o.total_price) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS orderCount FROM ticket_order o JOIN showtime s ON s.id = o.showtime_id WHERE o.status = 1 AND s.deleted = 0 GROUP BY s.cinema_id ) sales ON sales.cinema_id = c.id WHERE c.id = #{cinemaId} AND c.deleted = 0
